cases.name: update field
cases.input:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 5
cases.expected:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dep
spec:
  replicas: 42

cases.name: add field
cases.input:
apiVersion: custom/v1
kind: Custom
metadata:
  name: cus
spec:
  template:
    other: something
cases.expected:
apiVersion: custom/v1
kind: Custom
metadata:
  name: cus
spec:
  template:
    other: something
    replicas: 42

cases.name: add_field_null
cases.input:
apiVersion: custom/v1
kind: Custom
metadata:
  name: cus
spec:
  template:
    other: something
    replicas: null
cases.expected:
apiVersion: custom/v1
kind: Custom
metadata:
  name: cus
spec:
  template:
    other: something
    replicas: 42
